Titel: Interim Programme Manager SAP S/4HANA Global Roll-out
Unternehmen: Rheinmaas Specialty Chemicals B.V.
Ort: Kanaalweg 40, 3199 Rotterdam
Quelle: Freelancermap
Link: https://www.freelancermap.de/nproj/3190218.html
Abgerufen am: 22.09.2026 07:30

Ort: 3199 Rotterdam, Niederlande // Vertragsart: Freiberuflich // Start: 01/2027

Project description
Rheinmaas Specialty Chemicals is rolling out its SAP S/4HANA template from the pilot sites in the Netherlands to 11 plants in Germany, Belgium, Poland, Brazil and the United States. The template covers Finance, Procurement, Supply Chain, Production (PP-PI), Quality Management and EHS. We are looking for an experienced interim programme manager who takes over the roll-out from wave 2 onwards.

Tasks:
- Overall responsibility for roll-out waves 2 to 4 (Germany/Belgium, Poland, Americas)
- Steering of the system integrator and the local site teams
- Template governance: fit-to-standard workshops, localisation, change requests
- Cutover and hypercare planning per wave
- Monthly reporting to the Global Programme Board

Requirements:
- At least two completed SAP S/4HANA roll-outs in a leading programme role
- Experience in the process industry (chemicals, pharma) with SAP PP-PI, QM and EHS
- Experience managing large system integrators on fixed-price contracts
- Fluent English, German highly desirable (wave 2 runs in German)
- Willingness to travel (approx. 40 %, including Brazil and the USA)

Conditions:
Duration: 18 months
Workload: 100 %
Location: Rotterdam and plant sites, max. 1 day remote per week
Rate: EUR 1,300 to 1,500 per day plus travel expenses
